In /workspace/task, fix intervals.merge: touching half-open intervals must remain separate. Overlapping intervals must still merge, inputs may be unsorted, and the caller's list must not be changed. Inputs are valid integer (start, end) pairs with start < end. Preserve the public API and add appropriate regression coverage.

Booking intervals are half-open [start,end). merge returns sorted tuples and does not mutate inputs.

Runtime: Python 3.10+ standard library; no installation or network needed.
Existing smoke checks: python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
The merge condition currently treats touching endpoints as overlaps. I’ll make it strict and add tests for touching intervals, unsorted overlaps, and input preservation.
